title: Ay naserane Aza tumho fatima ki duaa
body:
Ay naserane Aza tum ho fatima ki dua, Sadae haye hussaina bapa karo harja, 1) bahao Ashke aza fatima ko do pursa, Karo hussain ka matam Suna k yeh noha.
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Kiya wo noha shahedee'n ne laashe Ghazi par, Ke jisko sunke sitamgar bhi karrahe the buka.
<<DIVIDER>>
3) ye bain karte hai kouno makaa'n me jinno bashar, Bulake dhoke se Aada ne sheh ko Qatl kiya.
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Ajeeb tarha ki shadi rachi hai karbal me, Hai pyase dulha dulhan aur Barati aale aba.
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Na tha layeno'n me kya koi sahebe aulaad, Sawale Aab pa Asghar ko teer se maara.
<<DIVIDER>>
6) tumhare sar pa hai Qayam Imam ka saya, Khosha naseeb ke tumko hai bawafa ki aata.
<<DIVIDER>>
7) Ye naseraane Aza ki sadaye hai moula, Fazai karbobala me sunaye yeh Noha
